cells.dependency_finding: The R all-sample AIPW path averages get_scores output and sums centered weighted scores within clusters for variance. Early guards reject clustered or sample-weighted TMLE despite later code containing cluster formulas. Continuous-treatment scores estimate conditional treatment variance with another regression forest and divide treatment residuals by it; zero/near-zero variance needs explicit handling and qualification. Causal bindings set the instrument index equal to treatment and call instrumental_predictor, which constructs InstrumentalPredictionStrategy. Its point output is a moment ratio, and native variance uses tree groups plus a Bayes debiaser. The initially fetched src binding is a symlink target string; implementation claims use the separately fetched target body and factory, not that string. compute_resid returns (a-b)/c. compute_density uses stats::density and linear interpolation with rule=2. The inspected kernel estimate_gps path evaluates density at standardized residuals and stores that value without a division by its scale in that path. A conditional density on the original exposure scale would require the Jacobian 1/scale under a location-scale model. The supplementary LICENSE file names year 2015 and Douglas Galagate; it supplements the previously inspected DESCRIPTION license declaration. It is not a full dependency or redistribution review.
cells.dependency_remaining: Inspect the Bayes debiaser, serialization, forest sample construction and numerical guards; compare all/treated/control/overlap and continuous-slope targets separately. Tree groups are not bank calendar clusters. Trace matching/weighting and counterfactual-dose prediction, inspect scale positivity, and reproduce heterogeneous-scale and dose-unit changes. The observed path alone does not establish all package outputs are wrong. Inspect full hi_est body and interval procedures, then resolve all dependency/distribution terms before an integration or port decision.
